evidence.scope: Offline byte-exactness proof: recompiling the flagship tree with the pinned profile reproduces the recorded init-code hash, the CREATE2 derivation and the 0x1440 permission bits; four tests, all passing locally under forge 1.5.1.
The hook source and its full compile closure in flagship/ were compared byte for byte against the Etherscan-verified standard-JSON input for the recorded contract address; every file matched exactly.

Machine-readable provenance for all four described contracts: addresses, CREATE2 records, compiler profile, dependency versions, runtime code hashes and upstream revision hashes, all cross-checkable against public chain state.

Behavioral suite over the exact production token and NFT sources wired with the real hook and renderer: ordinary transfers, 0/1/16/>16 retirements, LIFO order, PreparationRequired atomic unwind with the exact quote, holder-only prepareSell, full-balance exit with no third-party involvement, allowance-driven transferFrom, and batch bounds; eleven behavioral tests plus two token CREATE2 proof tests, all passing locally.

The RelicsToken and RelicsNFT sources in the flagship closure were compared byte for byte against their Etherscan-verified standard-JSON inputs at the recorded token and NFT identities; the union closure of all four contracts is fifty-eight files, all matching exactly.
